body_md:
**Trade review, Thu 19 Nov: UNIONBANK bought, 1 missed winner (CHENNPETRO), nothing closed.**

No exits today, so all 89 closed trades still total +153.2% (average +1.7%). Nifty rose 1.13% to 25,514.30. 15 trades are still running, 10 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 104 bought trades is +0.9%. Six new picks were listed, five of them candle-at-support F&O or midcap stocks (KEI, CGPOWER, IRCTC, PFC, RECLTD) plus GALLANTT. Tomorrow brings AEGISLOG's 30-day exit (−11.3%), then GOODLUCK, PNGSREVA and ASTRAL on 23 Nov.

**Today's results**
- 🟢 **UNIONBANK** (Candle at support, listed 18 Nov): bought: Filled at ₹206.03 today, just 0.3% above the zone bottom (₹205.49); now +1.93%. F&O stock with a strong hammer, but it listed on only 0.55× volume and rose 21% in the month before listing, so it sits in the run-up group.
- ⚪ **CHENNPETRO** (Candle at support, listed 16 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 0.46% of the zone top (₹1,394.62) but its 3-session window closed without a dip in. A buy at zone+2% or at the next open (₹1,418.10 on 17 Nov) would have reached T1 on 18 Nov; it is now +0.5%. Another candle-at-support pick listed just above the zone, like CGPOWER and TATAINVEST.

No wins closed today. Plus 60 earlier, among them IDFCFIRSTB, NMDC, SUNDARMFIN, PFC and TMPV (11 Nov). These 70 wins (55 at T2, 15 partial) made +353.5%; with the 19 failures (−200.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 89 closed trades total +153.2%. 7 of the 15 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (6): GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 4 of these 6 are below their buy price (PNGSREVA −12.2%, ASTRAL −8.6%, ESCORTS −6.7%, ONGC −0.3%).

**Missed and better entries**
- Missed winners now 20 of 32: CHENNPETRO is new tonight. 24 of the 32 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 94% vs 79% as listed: 14.5 points (the bar is 15), the closest yet. Its 106 closed trades made +182.9%, against +153.2% from 89 as listed, with 23 losing trades against 22.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.4% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.3 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 104 closed trades made +212.6% with 18 losing trades; average closed trade +2.0% against +1.7%.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.3% (closed and open), and their 24 closed trades net −68.6% with 11 of the 19 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 17 retest near misses logged since then: 6 at T1, 4 at T2, best rise 3.9% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** 13 of the 15 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing (FINCABLES and VMM yesterday did not). Those 40 trades average −3.3% and their 32 closed trades net −106.4%; the other 64 made +259.6% from 57 closed trades, 42 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (weakening)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 43 bought reached T1 (86%) and 30 reached T2 (70%); their 36 closed trades made +172.0% with 4 failures (VMM, CENTUM, WABAG and a flat LIQUIDBEES), and they dip least (−4.2%). (holding)
- **F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks:** 39 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (72%), worst dip −3.3%. 56 cash trades: 19 at T2 (34%), worst dip −11.5%. (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 20 of 32 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open (CHENNPETRO tonight); 24 of the 32 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (47 of 47). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%. Yesterday's early sign (both failures listed on weak volume) has nothing new tonight.

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Zone up to 2% above gets 14.5 points more fills against a bar of 15, with more T1 hits (94 vs 72), so it is close; if it clears 15 points while T1 holds, it qualifies. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+212.6% vs +153.2%), but its dip gain is 1.3 points against a bar of 2.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 104 bought = 55 at T2 + 15 partial + 19 failed + 15 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only price change against last night is UNIONBANK's new fill.
